evidence.note: D_FROZEN_MODEL_EMBEDDING is the model's own representation, not the observation contract, so it is reported but not used as an identifiability trigger

evidence.rule: onset overlap counts only if onset separates materially worse than late, since late is demonstrably identifiable at AUROC ~0.998; raw between-class distance alone confuses embedding compression with overlap

ensemble_uncertainty.degenerate_explanation: these reject the failures and retain active recall, but their median on ordinary quiet frames is on the wrong side of their median on the failures, so at the operating point they would also abstain on most genuinely quiet frames

group_definitions.hard_true_active: oracle-active frames whose old-head activity score is below the score of at least one historical false-positive frame, i.e. below the maximum of the 17

handoff_commit_discrepancy.assessment: one-character difference from the real commit db326d1, which is the commit that wrote the previous decision; treated as a transcription slip rather than an artifact mismatch, since every hash-verifiable artifact was checked independently and all matched

interpretation: next task may train one predeclared trajectory-bootstrap ensemble, use uncertainty only as an abstention signal, retain the seed-0 mean parked-field model unless a new model contract is explicitly approved, and qualify on development4 before confirmatory41

neighbour_ambiguity.asymmetry_finding: onset-ACTIVE frames sit among opposite-label neighbours most of the time, while onset-ZERO frames and the 17 failures do not. The ambiguity runs from active towards zero, which produces false negatives, not the false positives under investigation

hazard_separability_before_counterfactua.statistic: max current closeness over the whole field

separation_ratio.definition: between-class embedding distance divided by the mean within-class distance; 1.0 means the classes are indistinguishable in this space

frozen_model.previous_threshold_rule: frame-level 99th percentile of oracle-zero norms on 8 calibration trajectories

score_tail.note: full-range AUROC is deliberately not the headline; the upper tail and the clustering of errors are what determine usability

task: Determine whether the remaining activity failure is detectable through predictive uncertainty or is an intrinsic identifiability failure of the current deployable observation contract
